decision: Hold; no production promotion. VP8 paired signs split 3/6, VP9 320p median regresses and 5/6 pairs slower.
scope: Isolated byte-interleave experiment, PGO off; C intentionally skipped. Compare this job’s ASM/base/current on its Intel CPU only, without cross-job subtraction.
limits: All 22 semantic fields and allocations match in all 18 public samples plus both profile workloads. No raw timing or allocation sample was discarded.
The original checked c065 base beats original ASM on this Intel 8573C job in every public pair; this does not establish modern AMD 9V45 parity.
Small vertical UV kernel gains do not establish a stable encoder gain for the byte-interleave experiment. Unrelated all-six slower kernel controls are retained without causal attribution.
